messages:
maria: Quick alert — q4_0 quant rollout on nvA100 shows regressions on the gold completion suite (~4-7% EM drop on code category).
kevin: Any short examples or is this length/context dependent?
maria: Short example (before vs after):
```
before: def add(a, b):
    return a + b

after: def add(a, b):
    # forgot return
    a + b
```
maria: Also seeing extra-token shifts in long-context prompts — formatting and trailing tokens differ.
anjali: Note we relaxed dedupe threshold last week to 0.85 for sample expansion. Could be noisy duplicates in current gold.
kevin: I can re-run dedupe at 0.92 and grab a stratified sample.
sam: Labelers have 1.2k backlog. We can prioritize a 200-item relabel batch if we get ids + updated rubric.
label-bot: queued relabel job id=q-4982 for prioritized top-200. ETA 36h for first batch.
kevin: Sampling plan: 50 code, 50 instruction, 50 dialogue, 50 multi-turn. Command I used:
```
python tools/dedupe.py --input /data/promptsets/gold-candidates-2026.json --method fuzzy --threshold 0.92 --out /tmp/gold-reprobe-186512
```
anjali: Current rubric marks any missing token as full fail. That exaggerates code regressions. I'll PR a line-level partial credit scheme and add normalization (whitespace, comment tolerance).
sam: Will schedule 2 QA passes on relabeled gold and tag flaky examples.
ops-bot: deploy-bot started eval run eval-quant-audit-186512 at 1865124000; link: https://ci.redwood/evals/186512
maria: I'll run evaluation matrix: baseline float32, q3_k_m, q4_0. Will capture per-category EM/ROUGE/token-level diffs and save diff highlights.
kevin: If regressions persist after relabel we should prepare routing policy to serve non-quant fallback for Dedicated customers during the investigation.
anjali: PR for rubric posted: https://git.redwood/repo/prompt-evals/pull/621 — contains checklist and examples.
sam: Labeling notes: will exclude examples labeled FLAG_FLAKY from core metrics; will provide a CSV of relabels and disagreements.
maria: Action items recap: kevin — dedupe + sample files; anjali — rubric PR + label instructions; sam — prioritize labelers + QC; label-bot — execute relabel queue; maria — run evals and publish report. Check-in in 24h.
kevin: Sample files: /tmp/gold-reprobe-186512/ids.csv and manifest.json. I'll post results to #eng-ml-results after eval completes.
maria: thanks — please flag anything obviously flaky with FLAG_FLAKY in the label notes so we can filter.
